description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class named LocalSample, which serves as a front-end for launching the LocalSampleInstrumentation example instrumentation. It sets up a UI with a button that, when clicked, starts the specified instrumentation.

classes.description: An Android Activity that provides a UI with a button to launch an instrumentation test.
